findings.description: WebSurfer: WebSurfer returned general and unrelated information due to poorly refined queries and failed to identify the specific version of OpenCV where Mask-RCNN support was added. This failure caused subsequent steps to proceed based on incorrect or incomplete data, leading to the wrong final answer.
findings.notes: Who&When has who/when/reason only; no source taxonomy, so family=other.
